headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and a key single that scored two runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed right-handed pitcher Will Klein on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The San Francisco Giants placed catcher Jesus Rodriguez on the 10-day injured list with right elbow neuritis. The Seattle Mariners placed right fielder Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain.

The Kansas City Royals made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Lucas Braun from the Atlanta Braves in exchange for left-handed pitcher Carter Holton and center fielder Lane Thomas. The Seattle Mariners also made a trade, sending right-handed pitcher Luis Castillo to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for right-handed pitcher Seranthony Domínguez, catcher Boston Smith, and right fielder Nolan Jones.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and a key single that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow victory over the Chicago White Sox, winning 1-0. Drew Rasmussen led the Rays' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Tyler Phillips earned the win for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Place Will Klein on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Will Klein has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The move was made on August 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Braun in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have acquired right-handed pitcher Lucas Braun in a trade with the Atlanta Braves. Braun joins the Royals after being dealt for left-handed pitcher Carter Holton and center fielder Lane Thomas.
